scene.title: Quicksort Lomuto Partitioning
scene.summary: Walk through partitioning [7, 2, 1, 6, 8, 5, 3, 4] using the last element (4) as the pivot to separate smaller and larger elements.

beats.title: Select the pivot
beats.narration: We select the last element, 4, as the pivot. The goal is to move all elements ≤ 4 to its left and all elements > 4 to its right.

beats.title: Process 7, 2, and 1
beats.narration: 7 is greater than 4 and stays. 2 and 1 are smaller than 4, so each swaps forward into the left section.

beats.title: Process 6, 8, and 5
beats.narration: 6, 8, and 5 are all greater than 4, so the scan moves past them without swapping.

beats.title: Process element 3
beats.narration: 3 is less than 4, so it swaps with 7 at index 2 to extend the smaller elements partition.

beats.title: Place pivot in position
beats.narration: With all elements scanned, pivot 4 swaps with 6 at index 3. Pivot 4 is now in its exact sorted position!
